messages:
maya: Pausing the change window. CI artifact upload failing with a short write in the integration step; deploy-bot is retrying and blocking promote.

lee: Can you paste the uploader errors?

maya: Log snippet from bk-agent-2 @ 03:12 UTC:
```
[artifact-uploader] wrote 65536 bytes, then write returned: short write
ERROR upload aborted: short write while sending multipart chunk
```

infra-bot: ALERT: eu-west runner GC spike at 03:10 UTC (x5 baseline), several ephemeral volumes reclaimed.

alex: Looks correlated. If we wait we risk missing the change window. Options: retry (unknown), or pin the last-known-good artifact and manual-promote.

maya: Last promoted artifact: commit 1781120000, sha256:ffee1234abcd. I recommend manual-promote to keep the window and follow up with infra.

deploy-bot: ACTION: manual promote requires approver. Run `deploybot manual-promote --pin 1781120000 --reason "CI uploader short write"`.

lee: I approve.

maya: Kicking it now: `deploybot manual-promote --pin 1781120000 --author @maya`

bk-bot: PROMOTE STARTED: canary rollout for release 2026.03.23-pin-hotfix (pinned sha256:ffee1234abcd).

deploy-bot: PROMOTE SUCCESS: canary checks green. Monitoring window 15m.

maya: Filed infra#4999: "artifact uploader short write during runner GC spike; add stronger chunk retries and reduce chunk size". Added release note: "Hotfix: pinned to previous artifact (sha256:ffee1234abcd) due to CI uploader short write; infra follow-up (infra#4999)."

lee: Temporary mitigation: paused aggressive GC in eu-west for 20m. Will revert after the window and follow up on uploader hardening.

maya: Keeping change window open; will call rollback if canary degrades. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
